description: Explain why an exact StockLens reading says something, using evidence already produced; no credits, new analysis or writes. Use for a selected score reason, finding, qualification or assessment, including momentum, authorized moat or Beneish where produced. Copy reading_ref and the labelled view/selector from inspection arguments; overview is the default. A clear evidence request authorizes this read without another permission question. Follow a returned overview continuation only when more saved choices are needed; each call reads this same exact reading. Keep the company, date, reading kind/depth and all material context. USED_IN_ASSESSMENT, RELATED_OBSERVATION and FUTURE_CHECK have different roles. A selected_reason SOURCE_METRIC supplies its own saved interpretation; RELATED_ASSESSMENT is context, not evidence for that reason. Narrative sentences stay unbound. A standalone observation has no assessment-relative role; produced inapplicability can be inspected for its explanation, without a calculated score. Assessment-level unions do not prove per-sentence witnesses, a group is not a causal pair, and shared observations are not independent corroboration. Unknown, gated, expired and uncaptured detail stays typed; never substitute today's reading, retry unchanged or start a run to fill it. Pending/failed narrative does not erase deterministic evidence. Avoid repeating the same bound meaning as both narrative and finding. Only the four declared views are supported; this is not full structural inspection of every web card. An exact report link is optional. On request give the original dated evidence as history. Never offer an unsupported source as a current reason or question; only use supplied reading references and selectors.
